paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA, Sepaihte TOUPAN, Jerusalem kiang akipan leh Juda kianga kipan a muanpi u leh a muanpen uh a muanpi uh an teng teng leh a muanpi uh tui tengteng, a laksak san lai ahi;
english: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

paite: Mi hat leh kidousiamte toh; vaihawmmi leh jawlneimi leh, aisansiam leh, upate toh;
english: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

paite: Sawmnga heutu leh, mi zahtakhuai leh, lemtheimi leh, khutsiam leh jawlaisiam te toh.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

paite: Huchiin a mi liante ding ua om dingin naupangte ka pe dinga, naungekten a tunguah vai a hawm ding uh.
english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

paite: Huchiin, mite nuaisiahin a om ding ua, mi chih kinuaisiahin a om ding uh, mi chih amau insakinkhangte toh kiuaisiahin a om ding uh: naupang upa tungah kisathei takin a om ding ua, mi thulimloupi nangawn mizahtakhuai tungah kisathei takin a om ding.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.

paite: Min a unau a pa ina lenin, Nang silh leh ten na neia, ka vaihawmtu un om inla, hiai siatna na khut ah om heh, a chih chiangin:
english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

paite: Huaichiangin amah a pau khe dinga, kei jaw bawlhoihtuin ka om sin kei hi; ka in ah lah nekding a om keia, silh leh ten lah a om kei: mite vaihawmpain non bawl kei ding, chiin.
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

paite: A thupina mit vuisak dinga a pau u leh a thilhihte uh TOUPA dou lam a hih jiakin Jerusalem a se khina, Judate a pukkinta uhi.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

paite: A mel latdanin amau a hek tawma; a khelhna uh Sodom bang takin a langsak ua, a im kei uh. Atung uh gik e! thilhoihlouin a kithuk tawm ngal ua.
english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

paite: Mi diktat thu-ah A hoih sin uhi, chi un; a thilhih gahte ulah a ne sin ngal ua.
english: Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.

paite: Mi giloute tung a gik hi! Lah a se sin ngal ua; a khut ua thilhih thukna tuh a kiang ua piak a hih ding jiakin.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

paite: Ka mite jaw, amau nuaisiahtute naupangte a hita ua, numeiten a tunguah vai a hawmta uh. Ka mite aw, nou honpiten a honpi khial ua, na paina lamte a hihse sek uhi.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

paite: TOUPA tuh genpih dingin a hongding khiaa, mite vaihawm dingin a hongdingta hi.
english: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

paite: TOUPAN a mite upate tungah leh amau mi liante tungah vai a hawm ding: TOUPA, Sepaihte TOUPAN, Noute na hi uh, grep huan ne gaite; mi tangahte akipan sum lak na in uahte ahi a om:
english: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The spoil of the poor is in your houses.

paite: Bang achia ahia ka mite na at ua, tagahte mai na gawijan uh? achia.
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai louin TOUPA, Zion tanute kisathei taka a om ua, dak vuau vuau leh mi en loplopa a pai ua, a pai un a pai lohloh ua, a khete uh a suan ging thuapthuap jiak un.
english: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking to trip as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

paite: TOUPAN Zion tanute lujangah maimakhem a omsak dinga, TOUPAN a zhmohte uleng a dawksak ding a chi hi.
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

paite: Huai ni chiangin TOUPAN akizephoihnate uh a laksak dinga, khebulhte, len lukhu te, hakklote;
english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

paite: Bilbah kai ngaihngaihte, taute. kikhuhna puante;
english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

paite: Lutang puante, khebulh khainiang te, kawnga tente, gimlim bawmte, kikauna te;
english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume bottles, the charms,

paite: Min sawnna zungbuhte, nakbulhte;
english: the signet rings, the nose rings,

paite: Ankuangluina vante, puannak tualte, puan silhte, kawljalte;
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

paite: Limlangte, puanmalngatte, dial te, kituamhoihna puante.
english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

paite: Thau namtui tak sikin thil muat a om ding; huan, kawnggak sikin khaujen a om ding; huan, sam mam sikin talkolh a om ding; huan, puan kilawm tak sikin saiip puan ten a om ding: melhoih sikin melhoihloute a omding.
english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

paite: Na mite namsau vatpaihin a om ding ua, na mi hat mahmahte kidounaah a puk ding uh.A kulh kongkhakte a awm uh kitumin a kap ding ua; amah tuh a hawm dinga, leiah a tu ding hi.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

paite: A kulh kongkhakte a awm uh kitumin a kap ding ua; amah tuh a hawm dinga, leiah a tu ding hi.
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
